description:
Saves the one role the user said they are looking for on an account that has no role yet, creating its
profile when it has none. Recommendations then show that role's newest jobs in the account's place, and
later searches with no title search exactly that role. The FoundRole search panel calls it when the user
picks a role there; a role the user names in the chat is saved the same way. It saves only a role the user
chose, not a guess from their words. On an account that already has another role it changes nothing and
names the saved role; profile_role_replace replaces it.

career_profile_id.description: The FoundRole role the user chose, as careerProfileId from roles_lookup or a search question

name: profile_role_set
title: Save the role I am looking for
